title: Expert Pet Grooming for Cats | Furrever Love

facts.fact: The vendor's A La Carte list prices Ear Cleaning/Plucking at $10.
facts.quote: **Ear Cleaning/Plucking                    $10**

facts.fact: The vendor's A La Carte list prices Nail File/grinding at $20.
facts.quote: **Nail File/grinding                            $20**

facts.fact: The vendor's A La Carte list prices Nail Polish at $15.
facts.quote: **Nail Polish                                        $15**

facts.fact: The vendor's A La Carte list prices Hair Dye at $30 and up.
facts.quote: **Hair Dye                                           $30 and up**

facts.fact: The vendor's A La Carte list prices De-Shed/De-matt at $1 per minute.
facts.quote: **De-Shed/De-matt                          $1 per minute**

facts.fact: The vendor states the quoted grooming price is a base price for dogs on a 6-week schedule with 2" of coat or less.
facts.quote: The quoted price of grooming is a base price for dogs on a 6-week schedule with 2" of coat or less.

facts.fact: The vendor requires a 50% deposit to schedule an appointment, and the deposit is non-refundable.
facts.quote: A 50% deposit will be required to schedule an appointment and will be applied to your total. Deposits are NON-REFUNDABLE

facts.fact: The vendor charges a 20% cancellation fee if an appointment is cancelled less than 24 hours before but not on the same day.
facts.quote: there will be a fee of 20% if cancelled less than 24hrs but not the same day of appointment

facts.fact: The vendor charges a 30% fee for same-day cancellations.
facts.quote: 30% if cancelled on the Same Day of appointment

facts.fact: The vendor charges a 50% fee for a no call / no show.
facts.quote: 50% for a No Call / No Show

facts.fact: The vendor requires cancellations or reschedules to be reported by 5pm on the previous business day.
facts.quote: We require notification of any cancellation or rescheduling of an appointment by 5pm on the previous business day.

facts.fact: The vendor charges a $20 late drop-off fee if a customer arrives more than 15 minutes after the appointment time.
facts.quote: if you arrive later than 15 minutes of your appointment, we reserve the right to charge a $20 late drop off fee.

facts.fact: The vendor states an appointment may be rescheduled if the customer arrives more than 20 minutes late.
facts.quote: Any later than 20 minutes and your appointment is subject to be rescheduled.

facts.fact: The vendor states pets with fleas receive a mandatory flea bath with a $10 charge, depending on pet size and infestation severity.
facts.quote: Pets with fleas will be given a mandatory flea bath with a $10 charge depending on the size of pet and severity of the infestation.

facts.fact: The vendor charges $10 for the first 3 ticks found and $1 for each additional tick.
facts.value: 10 for first 3 ticks; 1 per additional tick
facts.quote: Any ticks found will result in a $10 charge for the first 3 ticks, plus $1 for each additional tick found.

facts.fact: The vendor charges $1 per minute for de-matting when matting is brushed out, and shaving to remove mats starts at $10.
facts.quote: Our de-matting service is charged by the minute at $1 per minute rate if we brush it out. If the severity of the matts require us to shave them off, our rates will start at $10

facts.fact: The vendor requires a Texas rabies vaccination record for pets, citing Texas state law.
facts.quote: Texas state law requires us to have your pet's rabies vaccination information on file.

facts.fact: The vendor will hold customers with repeated same-day cancellations or no-shows to prepaying the full price of future grooms.
facts.quote: Customers with repeated same day cancellations or no-shows will be required to prepay the full price of the groom for future appointments.

facts.fact: The vendor calls or texts customers 15 minutes before a pet is ready for pickup.
facts.quote: We will call and/or text you 15 minutes before your pet is ready for pick up.

facts.fact: The vendor states pets must be picked up within an hour of the ready call or text.
facts.quote: Pets must be picked up within an hour of that call and/or text

facts.fact: The vendor states it has over a decade of experience in the pet grooming industry.
facts.quote: With over a decade of experience in the pet grooming industry
